faces.name: Land Equilibrium
faces.oracle_text: If an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do would put a land onto the battlefield, that player instead puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice.

static_abilities.raw_text: If an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do would put a land onto the battlefield, that player instead puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice.

effects.text: that player instead puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice

condition.condition_text: an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do would put a land onto the battlefield
